summary: Bug fix testing complete - is_guest_booking boolean fix verified. The Python bug where 'x and y and z' returns last truthy value (phone string) instead of boolean has been fixed by wrapping with bool(). Both guest and authenticated booking flows work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix on line 1424-1425 is correct: is_guest_booking = bool(booking_data.guest_booking and booking_data.guest_name and booking_data.guest_phone)
Default availability in TimeSlotPicker.js is a good fallback for providers without set availability

tests: API returns is_guest_booking as boolean true (not phone string)
Guest booking with all fields (name, email, phone, address) works
UI: Select date → time slots appear → guest form → booking success
User ID correctly starts with 'user_' not 'guest_'
Time slots display even when provider has no availability set

bug_verification.original_bug: Python's 'and' operator returns last truthy value. So 'True and 'name' and '0501234567'' returned '0501234567' (string) instead of True (boolean)
bug_verification.fix_applied: Wrapped with bool() on line 1425: is_guest_booking = bool(booking_data.guest_booking and booking_data.guest_name and booking_data.guest_phone)
bug_verification.verification: API response now returns is_guest_booking: true (boolean) not '0501234567' (string)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Booking service bug fix has been verified. The is_guest_booking field now correctly returns boolean True/False. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_booking_bugfix.py can be used for regression testing.
